subtitle: Embedded Systems
teachers:

授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the basic mechanisms of microcontrollers and embedded programming.
advice:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Embedded programming with C/C ++ and assembly language.
2. Basics of microcontroller programming: digital I/O, analog digital conversion, pulse width modulation, and dynamic scanning.
requiredKnowledge:
Students of this course are expected to have the following:
1. C programming skills.
2. Understanding of the differences between IO mapped register and memory mapped register.

activityGoals.body: Be able to program using GPIO.
Be able to program using internal-timer function.
Be able to program using serial communication function.
Be able to program using interrupt service routine.
Be able to program using state machines.

achievementLevels.standard: Students with a standard achievement level can design and develop an application that can control devices.
